attributes.additional_details: Our green spaces and streets do not receive enough attention. Walking down the streets all you see is litter and other objects that do not belong in the natural world. We have reached the point in the world where if we do not make a difference now, we will not have an opportunity to go back. Our government claims they pay attention to the mess created by a majority of individuals and try their best to make it cleaner. However, I do not believe this. It needs fixing now, not later.
attributes.background: Our streets and green spaces require so much more attention than they are currently getting. Clean our streets and green spaces. Keep our world a clean and environmentally friendly space.

rejection.details: The cleanliness of our streets and open spaces is a matter for local authorities and we are not clear from your petition in the way in which you may want the Government to get involved.
